_meta.name: Books Read per Year
_meta.unit: mean books read, all or part of the way through, past year
_meta.note: "How many books did you read, either all or part of the way through, in the past year?" — interviewers count printed books, e-books, and audiobooks. Gallup's trend, asked seven times between 1990 and 2021 (an irregular cadence, shown honestly). LAST ASKED December 2021: the series is dormant until Gallup re-asks. The 2021 reading (12.6) was the lowest Gallup had measured, driven by fewer heavy readers (27% read 10+ books, down 8 points from 2016).
_meta.method: transcribed from the trend prose and chart on Gallup poll page 388541 (read 2026-08-31): 1990 15.3, 1999 18.5, 2001 14.5, 2002 15.8, 2005 14.2, 2016 15.6, 2021 12.6
